verdict.rationale: Autumn ships a CLI (atmn) with push/pull/preview/api commands and a full REST/SDK API (check, track, attach) that can be scripted in CI for pricing sync and billing automation, which supports headless/automation use. However, there's no explicit CI/CD documentation, no GitHub Actions examples, or dedicated non-interactive/headless mode guidance beyond general CLI usage. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless auth/token flow docs for automated environments, evidence of non-interactive mode or exit-code/scripting guarantees for atmn commands.
